(C) Qualification Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last Annual Turnover three years ending on 31st March of the previous year is not less than Rs. 9.00 Lakh

Normal duly hours will be Monday to Saturday. But in case of re quirement / emergency / need Driver may be asked on any Sunday or Holidays for duty. In case of monthly run o f the vehicle falls below 2000km, then balance KM will carry forward for excess run, beyo nd 2000km in any given month and shall be adjusted accordingly. Note: Bidders must keep in mind that the vehicle will be utilized for 24 x 7. Bid ders are requested to consider this aspect while quoting their rates. 2) Vehicle Running: The vehicle will run specifically in Kolkata city and its adjacent a rea. The vehicle may be run outside Kolkata as when required as instructed by Officer in Charge. Starting KM of vehicle will be recorded / counted from residence of Officer-in-Cha rge in New Town / Salt Lake area or as per the directions of the officer in Charge. 3) Extra Run: GeM terms and condition in this case is null and void. Extra running bey ond will be paid additional @ Rs. 12.00 per kilometer (km) including GST beyond 2000 k m run in a Month in line of Cl No. 2 above. 4) Extra Duty: GeM terms and condition in this case is null and void. Extra duty hours will be paid additional @ Rs.50.00 per hour including GST beyond 320Hrs in a Month. 5) Maintenance, repair and other charges: All types of repairing service provided b y the successful bidder shall be done by him at his Own cost and Monthly 01 (one) day wi ll be allowed for Repairing and Maintenance preferably on non-working day beyond duty h ours. If there is any repair / breakdown of for more than 3 hours or in case of absence, app licable amount shall be deducted on pro-rata basis from your bill. Any other charges relat ed like RTO, Insurance, Tax etc. will be paid by the successful Bidder. Any penalty/fine imposed by State Government official’s authority due to non-complian ce of statutory rules/safety rules & regulations etc. shall be borne by the service provid er and will be solely responsible for follow up of the case arising due to such situation and RITES will be in no way responsible for such act. 6) Log Book: Log Books shall be maintained to record the operation time shall be sign ed by RITES authorized representative. The bill shall be made on the basis of record in th e Log Book. The mileage & time reckoning shall be recorded / counted from residence of RITES Officer in Charge. 7) Safety Rule: Successful bidder has to follow all safety precautions rules as imposed by Central/State Govt. time to time. 8) Security of Vehicle: Security of the Vehicle deployed at site will be in bidder’s scope , nothing will be charged to RITES on this account under any circumstances whatsoever. In case of any accident to the vehicle, it will be the responsibility of the bidders or his

representative to lodge FIR etc. with police. All RTO issues and Traffic violations are to the a ccount of successful bidder. In such cases Driver’s responsibility if any shall be taken care by bidders only 9) Contract Period: Initially Contract Period is for 3 (Three) months. Contract may be e xtended beyond stipulated time or may be terminated before stipulated contract period at any time with 15 (fifteen) days’ prior notice without any financial repercussion/implication o n either side. 10) EMD/Bid Security: Not Applicable 11) Controlling Officer: The Officer-in-Charge for the above work, duly authorized by RITES Ltd., shall be intimated after the award of the contract. In this regard, all communications p ertaining to the execution of the work, including correspondence and guidance, shall be add ressed to and dealt with through the RITES Ltd. office at Kolkata. 12) Vehicle and Driver: The Model of Vehicle considered for this bid as mentioned in the bid or equivalent vehicle specification and vehicle should be commercial registration of 2024, 2 025 or latest. Bidders should quote the rates accordingly. Driver and vehicle should not be c hanged frequently especially in case of vehicle on monthly basis. If any most unavoidable t o circumstances bidder can change the driver / vehicle if required, but compulsory prior int imation should be given to the user concerned officials. Driver shall be supplied by bidder. Bidder shall submit the Driver’s Valid documents required to owner for Making Gate Passes. Whenever Main Driver is in leave, bidder needs to arrange Proper alternate driver without a ny extra cost to owner. If the vehicle not available due to driver absent, then the same day will be treated as no work no pay for both the driver and vehicle hire charges. It is mandatory to upload commercial registration certificate of the vehicle as pe r requirement of the bid. Vehicle provided by the service provider should be neat and clean. Curtain / Sunshade must be provided in the windows. White color seat covers are to be provided. Driver mu st be well known for the roads in the locality. Driver should be well dressed and good be havior. 13) In case of breakdown of the vehicle, the contractor shall provide the replacement (of s ame category vehicle) with a reasonable time falling which the touring executive will be entitled to hire any vehicle and complete the journey and amount thus incurred shall be r ecovered from the bills of the Contractor. 14) All kinds of repair / maintenance costs, charges of fuels, oil, lubricants, mobile phone c harges, fee towards license/registration, challans, salary/overtime of the driver, upto dat e comprehensive insurance / Pollution certificate etc. are responsibility of the contractor and shall be borne by the contractor throughout the duration of the contract. 15) The contractor shall ensure compliance of all applicable laws such as Motor Vehicle Ac t and adhered to legal and labour provisions provided by the Govt. of India/State which shall include income Tax, Accidents, Employee State Insurance, Provident Fund, Minimu m Wages Act, Contract Labour and abolition Act etc. The contractor shall provide all the necessary details as required by RITES for passing bill/invoice. 16) The contractor shall ensure that only payroll drivers should be deployed for duty. The drivers should be in proper uniform with name badges and photo identity card. 17) Along with every monthly bill of vendor is supposed to get certification from the user t hat the vehicle assigned is not more than 2 years old model and having valid PUC. 18) The contractor shall ensure that vehicles and the drivers are dedicated to the officer with whom vehicle is attached and changed only with their prior consent and with adva nce notice of at least 3 days, except in emergencies. Frequent changing of drivers of an d bringing drivers from far off places without proper knowledge of roads and driving skill shall not be resorted to. 19) The penalty for some of the defaults is as under:

a) Late reporting - 100/-Per day. b) Non-reporting - 1000/- Per day c) Refusal of duties - 500/-Per instance d) Change of drivers without prior intimation/ Providing improper drivers - 500/- per ins tance in case of non-reporting the per day rent for Vehicle on pro-rata basis will be deducted apart from the above penalty. e) Unclean vehicle or seat covers/ smell in the vehicle-(i) Rs.50/- for the first day (ii) Rs . 200/- per day for the second consecutive day and beyond as pointed out by the con trolling officer of the vehicle. f) On misbehavior by the Driver: - Rs.500/- per default, if the misbehavior continues, t hen the driver will have to be changed by the contractor. If the contractor does not change the driver within 3 days’ time, the vehicle will be sent back and a taxi may b e hired. The payment of such taxi will be borne by the contractor along with a fine of Rs.200/- daily; g)Recurrent malfunctioning/ dissatisfactory condition of the vehicle:- The vehicle will b e returned. A vehicle may be hired by the concerned officer/ office, payment of whic h will be borne by the contractor along with a daily fine of Rs.500/- till such time a pr oper vehicle is provided by the contractor h) During the contract period if any of the vehicle is seized/detained/ impounded by th e Police, Transport Officer or any other Authority for any reason whatsoever, it will b e at the sole risk responsibility of the contractor, who shall immediately provide anot her vehicle of the same seat capacity in lieu thereof, otherwise a penalty of Rs.1500/ - per day will be imposed. 20) Copies of Valid Registration Certificate, insurance, Taxes & pollution clearance to be s ubmitted immediately after issue of LOA/WO at the time of providing vehicle and the c harges for these to be borne by the agency. The vehicle should be in the name of servi ce provider/Owner of travel agency. Vehicle must be registered as per motor vehicle Act and have relevant permit with We st Bengal State Govt. Transport Authority, Expenditure towards registration of vehicles , Road Tax, Commercial Vehicle Tax permit etc. with state Govt. Transport Authority wi ll be borne / settled by the owner of vehicle during the contract period. 21) Price: Rate quoted shall remain firm without any escalation on any account till the co mpletion of Job and the order in executed in all respects. 22) For violation/breach of any of the condition of the contract:- Rs.1000/- per default and/ or Termination of the contract/forfeiture of Performance Security. In case of breach of c ontract by the contractor, the Performance Security shall be forfeited by the Governme nt and the firm shall be blacklisted in addition to termination of the contract in question . The right of action will rest with the authority entering into the agreement. 23) Performance Security: Performance Security @5% of the value of contract required to be submitted by successful bidders. In case of any extension of contract obligation p eriod, the seller shall be liable to suitably extend the validity of the Performance Securit y. 24) Payment Terms: Payment will be made within 30 days from the date of submission Ta x Invoice along with copy of Log sheet. No advance payment shall be entertained. 25) Income Tax: Income tax will be deducted from bill as per Govt. rules. 26) Right to accept or reject the offer: The Company reserve the absolute right to reject any or all offers and /or to cancel the Tender without assigning any reason whatsoever, thereof. The Tend erer whose tender is not accepted shall not be entitled to claim any cost, charges or expenses i ncidental to or incurred by him through or in connection with the preparation and submission of the offer to the Company. RITES has right to terminate the contract in any time with or without notice period. 27) Other Terms and Conditions will be governed by extant rule available in GEM. .
